conceptual_source.author: Sebastian Raschka

conceptual_source.role: Inspiration for the visual sequence and subsequent permutation examples; the former feature-selection context on route 61 is replaced by selected categories from Molnar.

interpretation_source.author: Christoph Molnar
interpretation_source.opening_map: Interpretability → Post-hoc → Model-agnostic → Global → Feature importance → PFI. This is a didactic route through selected categories from the methods overview, not the complete book taxonomy or the permutation algorithm steps.

presentation.author: William Bendinelli
presentation.row_diagrams: Fixed real SRAG receivers, selected as the first adult records per observed outcome, are a window into the first registered full temporal-test permutation. Donor values come from all evaluation rows. Original receiver inputs and predictions stay unchanged; recorded predictions are replayed, not calculated by XGBoost in the browser.
presentation.results: The mechanism error chart uses the original global log loss and the repeated full-test mean and sample shuffle SD. The displayed first global repetition is identified separately. Receiver losses are audited in notebooks, not used as the chart estimate. Ranking and repeat trace use the same complete temporal evaluation.
presentation.source_figures: modules/06-pfi/figures, regenerated with tools/srag_75_pfi_figures.py from the recorded full-test log loss traces and independently reproduced dependence diagnostics in modules/06-pfi/notebooks/pfi_walkthrough.ipynb and pfi_internals.ipynb.
presentation.aggregate_source: Recorded full-test log loss traces in modules/00-dataset/gold/pfi_ranking.json, combined with independently reproduced dependence diagnostics in modules/06-pfi/evidence/pfi_metric_comparison.json. The historical modules/00-dataset/gold/pfi_slide_explainer.json supplies recorded study metadata and labels. Explicitly projected by tools/srag_72_pfi_presentation.py.
presentation.teaching_source: modules/06-pfi/evidence/pfi_teaching_demo.json, generated by tools/srag_73_teaching_demo.py in pfi_walkthrough.ipynb §3 and independently reproduced in pfi_internals.ipynb §5. tools/srag_72_pfi_presentation.py explicitly projects it into data/pfi-teaching-records.json and checks first global errors against modules/00-dataset/gold/pfi_ranking.json.
presentation.historical_teaching_source: modules/00-dataset/gold/pfi_slide_explainer.json preview is preserved unchanged. Its manual subset order and measured losses document the previous mechanism and its correction; they do not feed the current animation.
presentation.primary_metric: Log loss, averaged negative natural logarithm of the probability assigned to each observed outcome. Full-test charts share one original baseline; the final subgroup illustration declares its separate subset and baseline.
presentation.subgroup_source: modules/06-pfi/evidence/pfi_age_cardiopathy.json, generated in pfi_internals.ipynb §9 from the continuous-age comparison in §8. Age bands are for display; heart disease defines the fixed groups. The separate diabetes comparison remains in modules/06-pfi/evidence/pfi_diabetes_subgroups.json.
presentation.model_selection_source: data/model-selection.json, validated by tools/srag_72_pfi_presentation.py against the module 00 records. Historical AUC selection, the subsequent validation-log-loss family comparison and the separate XGBoost balancing review remain distinguished.

included_data: Explicitly selected global, model-selection, subgroup and teaching-window projections. Aggregate files contain recorded errors, ranking summaries, repeat traces, study counts, model-selection comparisons, selected subgroup compositions and fixed-model protocols. The teaching window contains unchanged receiver inputs/outcomes, original and first-global-repeat probabilities/classes/log loss penalties, received input values and the global permutation protocol. Received values are real; permuted records are artificial combinations. Source identifiers, dates, location fields, donor identifiers/positions/outcomes, unselected research association tables and snapshots are excluded. Identifier omission is not a claim of anonymization.
